transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Let's get started on the package-lock review for 'Midnight Arcade.' I need signoffs from rights, post-production, and publicity before I can approve the delivery package. Could each of you report any required changes to the current draft? As a reminder, the package currently lists worldwide delivery, our standard music credit, a 4K UHD 24 fps master, English subtitles, and a June 14 publicity release.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a rights issue. I reviewed the countersigned music license this morning, and it restricts distribution to the United States and Canada only — not worldwide as currently listed. Additionally, the required credit must be exactly 'Music licensed courtesy of Northline Songs,' which differs from our standard music credit. I haven't entered these terms into the delivery tracker yet due to the ongoing rights database migration, but these are binding requirements we need to reflect in the package.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a post-production issue. I received the broadcaster's completed ingest test today and confirmed that delivery must be an IMF package at 25 fps with English SDH captions. The draft 4K UHD 24 fps master and ordinary English subtitle file will fail the partner's ingest specification. I have the result saved in the post-production test folder pending this routine package-lock meeting.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a publicity issue. I confirmed with the artist's representative this afternoon that publicity for 'Midnight Arcade' is embargoed until June 21 — not June 14 as currently listed in the draft package. The representative will reject any public release dated earlier than June 21. I should note that my approval email is currently attached to the publicity calendar rather than the delivery tracker, but this is a binding requirement we need to reflect in the package.
transcript.speaker: A4

decisions.music_credit: Music licensed courtesy of Northline Songs

commitments.detail: Enter the countersigned music license terms — US/Canada only distribution and the exact credit 'Music licensed courtesy of Northline Songs' — into the delivery tracker once the rights database migration is complete.

Update the delivery package to specify an IMF package at 25 fps with English SDH captions instead of the 4K UHD 24 fps master and ordinary English subtitle file. Ensure the completed ingest test result is reflected in the delivery tracker.
Update the publicity release date to June 21 in the delivery package and attach the artist representative's embargo confirmation to the delivery tracker alongside the publicity calendar entry.
Once all three departments have confirmed the updated terms are entered in the delivery tracker, reconvene for final package-lock approval.
